recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not add duplicate source files or redundant narrative; the spreadsheet-backed mapping data and generated ConceptMap pages already satisfy FHIR-15904, and FHIR-16189 indicates the remaining SNOMED CT request was intentionally not applied.
issue_request: FHIR-15904 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked to restore the FHIR-v2 and FHIR-v3 AdministrativeGender ConceptMaps that existed in DSTU2 on the current AdministrativeGender value set page.
initial_application: No prior git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-15904. The AdministrativeGender v2/v3 mapping data was already present in source/terminologies/bindings.xml from older gender-code work, and the issue's Jira comment recorded Grahame Grieve's conclusion that the maps were already there.
additional_context: FHIR-16189 is the same AdministrativeGender concept-map family but concerns duplicate rendering and a proposed SNOMED CT map. Its resolution rejected the SNOMED CT map and treated duplicate v2/v3 listings as a tooling/rendering issue. The linked Zulip thread confirms the mappings are sourced from bindings.xml and that rendering was considered fixed.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. source/terminologies/bindings.xml already has the v2 and v3 AdministrativeGender mapping rows, including both v2 A and O targets for the FHIR other code, and build.fhir.org exposes cm-administrative-gender-v2.html and cm-administrative-gender-v3.html with the expected generated mappings.
